1	Back to front page	A40. Trade by regions 1710-1822 based on official values																							
2		Source: Moreau (1822) from Mitchell (1988).  England and Wales to 1754 (Imports)/1758(Exports), Great Britain thereafter.																							
3		These data are based on official values which were based on prices largely set and fixed at the end of the C17th.  So they do not accurately reflect the value of trade although this is unlikely to give a distortionary picture until the late C18th.  From 1784 the declared and computed values in the next sheet are to be preferred.
